guide.mdvlcraft.page.1:
§lMDVLCraft§r

Your character is built from three origins and two classes.

Everything in this guide is in the menu: press §l%1$s§r.

The pages that follow cover each part.
guide.mdvlcraft.page.2:
§lOrigins§r

On first join you pick three:

§lRace§r - your people
§lJob§r - your trade
§lMartial§r - how you fight

Hover each one on the Status page (%1$s → Status) to read its powers.
guide.mdvlcraft.page.3:
§lChanging origins§r

An §lOrb of Origin§r resets all three and lets you choose again.

Craft it from an enchanted golden apple surrounded by 8 gold ingots.
guide.mdvlcraft.page.4:
§lClasses§r

Open %1$s → Skills → Classes and pick up to two archetypes.

Two together give you a combined class and a title shown in chat.
guide.mdvlcraft.page.5:
§lSkill trees§r

Each archetype has its own tree. You get 1 point to start and 1 per level, with no level cap.

Abilities sit toward the middle and ends of the trees.
guide.mdvlcraft.page.6:
§lAbilities§r

Unlocked spells and techniques go on the ability wheel.

Hold §l%2$s§r to choose one, press §l%3$s§r to cast it.

Epic Fight skills go in the Combat Skills box on the Abilities screen.
guide.mdvlcraft.page.7:
§lMana§r

Spells and techniques cost mana. Mana stops refilling while you spend it and starts again one second after.

Tree bonuses raise your mana, regen and cooldown reduction.
guide.mdvlcraft.page.8:
§lRespec§r

%1$s → Respec lets you reset a tree (every point back) or swap one class for another.

A new class starts at three quarters of the old one's level.
guide.mdvlcraft.page.9:
§lDowned§r

At zero health you bleed out instead of dying straight away. Another player can revive you by holding use (right-click) on you.

Hold §l%4$s§r to give up.

Good luck.

ability.mdvlcraft.planned_frostfire_bolt: A bolt of fire and ice: it burns and slows at the same time.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_frozen_sea.des: A frost wave that freezes water into walkable ice wherever it passes.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_funayurei.desc: Raise drowned ghosts with ladles that drag enemies down and slow them.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_geyser.desc: A water eruption under the target that launches it into the air.
Fire an arrow with a rope; you are pulled to wherever it lands.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_grave_rob.desc: Dig up graves: digging soil or gravel has a chance to drop bones, gold or a skeleton that fights you.
spell.mdvlcraft.guardian_angel.guide: Summon an angel (a reskinned vex) that heals you and allies instead of attacking.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_hailstorm.desc: A rain of hail that damages and slows everything beneath it.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_harpoon.desc: Fire a harpoon from your crossbow that drags the target to you.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_haunting.desc: Leave a ghostly copy of yourself that enemies attack; when it is struck it shrieks and makes them flee for 3 s.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_heat_mirage.de: A heat shimmer: mobs lose track of you, and you take less fire damage while it lasts.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_holy_avenger.d: Angel wings that also make every melee hit call down a small sunbeam on the target.
spell.mdvlcraft.holy_shield.guide: A shield of light that blocks projectiles and heals allies standing behind it.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_holy_water.des: A ball of blessed water that heals allies it splashes and burns undead.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_honor_guard.de: Summon a spirit samurai with a tower shield that taunts enemies near you and takes hits for you.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_hot_spring.des: A steaming pool that heals allies in it and thaws freezing.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_hungry_ghost.d: For 15 s every kill releases a hungry ghost that flies at the nearest enemy and soulburns it; each kill extends the time.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_hunter_trap.de: Place a hidden bear trap that roots and bleeds the first enemy to step on it.
spell.mdvlcraft.hunting_hawk.guide: A hawk companion that circles you, marks the nearest enemy with Glowing and dives at it.
spell.mdvlcraft.iaido.guide: A katana-only dashing draw cut; a parry in the 2 s before it doubles its damage.
spell.mdvlcraft.ice_dagger.guide: Throw a dagger of ice; it deals triple damage from behind and freezes.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_ice_wall.desc: Raise a wall of ice instead of fire: it blocks movement and projectiles, then shatters into frost.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_iceberg.desc: Drop a huge ice block onto the target from far above.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_igloo.desc: Raise a snow shelter around you: allies inside are protected from cold and regenerate.
spell.mdvlcraft.immolate.guide: A scorch that deals triple damage when it hits a target from behind.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_immortal_peach: Conjure a peach that heals a lot and gives Regeneration and Resistance.
spell.mdvlcraft.iron_body.guide: Harden your body: large damage reduction and knockback immunity, but you move slower while it lasts.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_jade_barrage.d: After the cast, a barrage of jade shards instead of soul skulls; each hit shatters armour.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_jade_lotus.des: A jade lotus that heals allies and grants Symmetry resistance.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_jade_nova.desc: A burst of jade shards around you instead of soul fire: symmetry damage that shatters armour.
spell.mdvlcraft.jade_serpent.guide: A jade serpent spirit that coils around the target and crushes it.
spell.mdvlcraft.jade_skin.guide: Jade skin: damage reduction, and melee attackers take a little damage back.
spell.mdvlcraft.javelin.guide: Throw your held spear; it pierces through the first target and flies back to your hand.
spell.mdvlcraft.jiangshi_fists.guide: Become a jiangshi for a while: your unarmed hits drain health and you hop instead of walk.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_kami_shrine.de: Raise a small forest shrine: its kami heals allies near it and roots enemies that come close.
spell.mdvlcraft.ki_wave.guide: A channelled beam of raw ki from both palms (Ray of Frost with blue spirit energy, no freezing).
spell.mdvlcraft.kunai_rain.guide: In the air, throw a fan of five kunai where you look.
Dive from a height and land on a target below with an assassination strike that takes no fall damage.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_lich_form.desc: Become a lich for a while: you cannot be healed but your spells cost health instead of mana and hit harder.
Allies around you gain a shield; lightning that hits you or them is redirected to you and absorbed.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_lockpick.desc: Touch a locked chest, door or vault to open it without the key (unlocks loot chests in structures).
spell.mdvlcraft.lotus.guide: A lotus opens beneath you, healing allies and cleansing one harmful effect from each.
spell.mdvlcraft.magpies.guide: Magpies dive at enemies and knock the item out of a mob's hand.
spell.mdvlcraft.mirror_image.guide: Split into three short-lived copies that confuse enemies; only one is real.
spell.mdvlcraft.mist_step.guide: Teleport in a burst of sea mist that blinds enemies around where you left.
spell.mdvlcraft.mushin.guide: Focus that also makes any parry in the next 3 s count as a perfect parry.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_net_throw.desc: Throw a net that pins and slows the first creature it hits.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_night_parade.d: A short night parade of yokai sweeps forward through your enemies, soulburning and weakening everything it passes.
spell.mdvlcraft.nomad_mount.guide: An armoured warhorse that is faster and can carry a rider into battle.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_ofuda.desc: Throw a paper talisman that seals spirits: holy damage, double to the undead and to summons, and silences the target for 2 s.
spell.mdvlcraft.oni_summon.guide: Summon a towering spirit oni with a kanabo instead of a samurai.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_onibi.desc: Three ghost-fire wisps drift after enemies and burn them with soul fire that ignores fire resistance.
spell.mdvlcraft.pack_mule.guide: Summon a spectral mule with a chest that follows you.
spell.mdvlcraft.palm_blood.guide: A palm strike of blood that leeches a third of the damage, hitting everything in a short cone ahead. Needs empty hands, gloves or a fist weapon.
spell.mdvlcraft.palm_eldritch.guide: A palm strike of void that pulls enemies in, hitting everything in a short cone ahead. Needs empty hands, gloves or a fist weapon.
spell.mdvlcraft.palm_holy.guide: A palm strike of holy light that heals you for a quarter of the damage, hitting everything in a short cone ahead. Needs empty hands, gloves or a fist weapon.
spell.mdvlcraft.palm_ice.guide: A palm strike of ice that freezes, hitting everything in a short cone ahead. Needs empty hands, gloves or a fist weapon.
spell.mdvlcraft.palm_lightning.guide: A palm strike of lightning that stuns, hitting everything in a short cone ahead. Needs empty hands, gloves or a fist weapon.
spell.mdvlcraft.palm_nature.guide: A palm strike of thorns that poison, hitting everything in a short cone ahead. Needs empty hands, gloves or a fist weapon.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_palm_soul.desc: A palm strike of soul fire that soulburns, hitting everything in a short cone ahead. Needs empty hands, gloves or a fist weapon.
spell.mdvlcraft.palm_spirit.guide: A palm strike of jade that shatters armour, hitting everything in a short cone ahead. Needs empty hands, gloves or a fist weapon.
spell.mdvlcraft.palm_water.guide: A palm strike of water that knocks back hard, hitting everything in a short cone ahead. Needs empty hands, gloves or a fist weapon.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_phantom_draw.d: A dashing draw cut that leaves a phantom samurai behind, which repeats the cut a moment later.
Wings of fire: fly, and enemies you fly over are set alight.
spell.mdvlcraft.pickpocket.guide: Grip a creature and pull one item from its loot table out of it (once per creature).
spell.mdvlcraft.pirate_crew.guide: Summon a crew of three drowned pirates with swords.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_plasma_ball.de: A ball of lightning that bursts into fire when it pops.
spell.mdvlcraft.provoke.guide: Instead of a decoy goat, every mob nearby targets you and you gain Resistance I while it lasts.
spell.mdvlcraft.quake_slam.guide: A heavier stomp that also roots enemies in place for 2 s.
spell.mdvlcraft.radiant_dagger.guide: Throw a dagger of light that burns undead and marks the target with Glowing.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_raijin_drums.d: Spirit drums beat overhead: each beat strikes an enemy near you with lightning, and the last one soulburns them all.
spell.mdvlcraft.rally.guide: Plant a banner that gives allies around it Resistance I and slow regeneration.
spell.mdvlcraft.reanimate.guide: Raise the dead with lightning: they are fast and their hits spark.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_reaper_mark.de: Mark an enemy; when it dies its soul is torn out and bursts, soulburning every enemy around it.
spell.mdvlcraft.river_dragon.guide: A jade river dragon instead of a sea serpent: it heals allies it passes.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_sanctify.desc: Holy grass grows around you; allies on it regenerate.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_scald.desc: A cone of steam that burns and blinds.
spell.mdvlcraft.sculk_watcher.guide: Summon a small sculk creature that blinds and sonic-pulses nearby enemies.
spell.mdvlcraft.seraph_embodiment.guide: Become a seraph of many eyes and wings for up to 30 s (cast again to leave): fly slowly, cast only spells, with 20% more spell power, faster mana regeneration and Regeneration. You cannot attack, use items or other abilities, and only your eye can be hit.
spell.mdvlcraft.shadow_clone.guide: Summon two clones of yourself that fight with your held weapon instead of casting spells.
spell.mdvlcraft.shadow_guard.guide: A shield of shadow that, when it breaks, turns you invisible for 3 s.
spell.mdvlcraft.shield_bash.guide: With a shield in the off hand, slam it into the target in reach: stuns and knocks it back.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_silent_shot.de: An invisible arrow that makes no sound and always crits from stealth.
spell.mdvlcraft.skeleton_archers.guide: Raise skeleton archers that shoot from range.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_smite_bolt.des: A golden bolt from the heavens: double damage to undead.
spell.mdvlcraft.smoke_bomb.guide: A burst of smoke that blinds everything in it and gives you a few seconds of invisibility.
spell.mdvlcraft.snow_sentinels.guide: Summon snow golems whose snowballs slow and chill enemies.
spell.mdvlcraft.snow_spirit.guide: Summon small snow spirits that fly at enemies and freeze them.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_soul_cleave.de: An axe cleave that tears at the soul: soulburns everything hit and heals you for a little of the damage.
A blue soul-fire fireball that ignores fire resistance.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_soul_harvest.d: A beam that pulls the soul out of an enemy: drains health and mana, and soulburns it.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_soul_lantern.d: A pale soul lantern drifts to the target and bursts in soul fire, applying soulburn.
spell.mdvlcraft.soul_reaper.guide: A wide blood slash; each enemy it kills rises as a weakened skeleton that fights for you.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_soul_rend.desc: A dash that strikes once with each hand; both hits soulburn and each target hit restores a little mana.
spell.mdvlcraft.spectral_boat.guide: Summon a ghostly boat that is faster than a normal one.
spell.mdvlcraft.spider_brood.guide: Summon a brood of cave spiders whose bites poison.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_spirit_aegis.d: A shield of ancestral spirits that blocks projectiles; anything that strikes it is soulburned.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_spirit_communi: Sneak still to channel: spirits gather round you, restoring mana and stamina, and you keep 20% more spirit spell power for 20 s after.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_spirit_hawk.de: A ghost hawk that flies through walls, marks the nearest enemy with Glowing and soulburns it when it dives.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_spirit_steed.d: Summon a spectral horse that runs over water and through tall grass without slowing.
spell.mdvlcraft.spirit_step.guide: Teleport where you look, leaving a spirit double that taunts enemies and bursts.
spell.mdvlcraft.spirit_tiger.guide: Summon a single white tiger spirit that fights beside you.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_spirit_ward.de: Ancestral spirits circle you and absorb damage; each hit they absorb burns the attacker with soulburn.
spell.mdvlcraft.spirit_wolf.guide: Summon a single great spirit wolf that bites with soulburn.
spell.mdvlcraft.stance_blood.guide: A new form for Stance: cast to switch into it (it also joins the sneak-cast cycle). While in it, your katana strikes deal 20% more and heal you for a tenth of it.
spell.mdvlcraft.stance_eldritch.guide: A new form for Stance: cast to switch into it (it also joins the sneak-cast cycle). While in it, your katana strikes weaken and pull the foe in.
spell.mdvlcraft.stance_fire.guide: A new form for Stance: cast to switch into it (it also joins the sneak-cast cycle). While in it, your katana strikes set foes on fire.
spell.mdvlcraft.stance_holy.guide: A new form for Stance: cast to switch into it (it also joins the sneak-cast cycle). While in it, your katana strikes heal you a little and deal more to the undead.
spell.mdvlcraft.stance_ice.guide: A new form for Stance: cast to switch into it (it also joins the sneak-cast cycle). While in it, your katana strikes slow and chill.
spell.mdvlcraft.stance_lightning.guide: A new form for Stance: cast to switch into it (it also joins the sneak-cast cycle). While in it, your katana strikes stagger and arc a third of the damage to a nearby foe.
spell.mdvlcraft.stance_nature.guide: A new form for Stance: cast to switch into it (it also joins the sneak-cast cycle). While in it, your katana strikes poison.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_stance_soul.de: A new form for Stance: cast to switch into it (it also joins the sneak-cast cycle). While in it, your katana strikes soulburn.
spell.mdvlcraft.stance_spirit.guide: A new form for Stance: cast to switch into it (it also joins the sneak-cast cycle). While in it, your katana strikes shatter armour.
spell.mdvlcraft.stance_water.guide: A new form for Stance: cast to switch into it (it also joins the sneak-cast cycle). While in it, your katana strikes knock back and refund a little stamina.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_static_snare.d: A crackling snare that stuns the target and makes it drop what it holds.
spell.mdvlcraft.stealth_summons.guide: Summon two invisible shadow hounds that only show themselves when they bite.
spell.mdvlcraft.still_mind.guide: Sneak still to channel: restores mana and stamina instead of other players' health.
spell.mdvlcraft.stone_fist.guide: A plain, heavy palm strike that knocks the target back and breaks its guard.
spell.mdvlcraft.storm_crows.guide: Crows wreathed in lightning dive at enemies.
spell.mdvlcraft.storm_hounds.guide: Summon wolves wreathed in lightning whose bites chain a spark to a nearby enemy.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_storm_sea.desc: A thunderstorm with heavy rain: lightning strikes wet enemies first and twice as hard.
spell.mdvlcraft.storm_steed.guide: A horse of lightning that is very fast and shocks what it runs through.
spell.mdvlcraft.strays.guide: Raise frozen skeletons (strays) whose arrows slow.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_superconductor: Chain lightning that jumps twice as far between frozen targets and freezes them solid.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_taiji_seal.des: A yin-yang seal on the ground: allies inside heal slowly, enemies inside take symmetry and spirit damage in turns.
spell.mdvlcraft.terracotta.guide: Summon a jade terracotta soldier that guards you with a halberd.
A fireball that explodes for double damage on a frozen or chilled target.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_thorn_volley.d: A volley of thorns that poison and slow.
spell.mdvlcraft.thunder_charge.guide: Launch forward in a crackle of lightning, shocking everything you pass through.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_thunder_slam.d: Stomp the ground; lightning strikes every enemy the shockwave hits.
spell.mdvlcraft.thunder_step.guide: Teleport up to 14 blocks where you look in a flash of lightning; enemies near where you leave and where you land are shocked and staggered.
spell.mdvlcraft.thunderbird.guide: A great storm phantom that circles overhead and calls lightning down on enemies near you.
spell.mdvlcraft.tide_charge.guide: Launch forward on a surge of water, sweeping enemies aside.
spell.mdvlcraft.tide_guardians.guide: Summon allied guardians (the ocean-monument fish) that beam your enemies.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_totem_ward.des: A totem that heals allies in its circle instead of hurting enemies.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_tracking.desc: Every creature nearby glows and leaves a visible trail for a while.
spell.mdvlcraft.trail_rations.guide: Conjure food for the whole party that also gives a short Regeneration.
spell.mdvlcraft.treant.guide: Summon a treant (a reskinned iron golem) that roots what it hits.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_trident_rain.d: A volley of tridents instead of arrows; they soak and slow.
spell.mdvlcraft.twin_fang.guide: A dash that strikes once with each hand, using both weapons' damage.
spell.mdvlcraft.vampire_bite.guide: A bite from behind that drains three times as much health.
spell.mdvlcraft.void_pet.guide: Summon a void hound that blinks behind what it hunts.
spell.mdvlcraft.void_shiv.guide: Throw a dagger of void that teleports you to where it lands.
spell.mdvlcraft.void_strider.guide: Summon a black horse of the End that blinks forward a few blocks at a time while you ride.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_void_tide.desc: A black tsunami from the abyss that blinds and drags enemies with it.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_void_yokai.des: Summon small void yokai that blink to enemies and weaken them.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_war_banner.des: Plant a banner that gives allies around it Strength I.
spell.mdvlcraft.war_frenzy.guide: Rage: attack speed and life steal for 10 s, but you take 20% more damage.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_warcry.desc: A roar that makes every mob nearby target you and gives you Strength I while they do.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_wayshrine.desc: Set a small roadside shrine; cast again from anywhere in the same dimension to return to it.
spell.mdvlcraft.whirlpool_kick.guide: A spinning kick wrapped in water that drags nearby enemies in.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_wildfire.desc: A blaze storm that spreads fire across grass and leaves around the target.
spell.mdvlcraft.wolf_pack.guide: Summon a pack of wolves that hunts with you.
ability.mdvlcraft.planned_wraith_chill.d: A breath of grave-cold spirit frost that slows and soulburns everything in the cone.
